up: Return IC50 activity data for CHEMBL3183703 and all of its salt forms against the target NACHT, LRR and PYD domains-containing protein 3 (CHEMBL1741208). For each matching activity, provide the following details: compound ChEMBL ID, compound preferred name, canonical SMILES structure, activity ID, assay ChEMBL ID, assay description, target ChEMBL ID, standard relation, standard value, standard units, pChEMBL value, document ID, PubMed ID, and DOI.
sql:
WITH target_mols AS (
    SELECT parent.molregno AS parent_molregno
    FROM molecule_dictionary parent
    WHERE parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3183703'
), all_mols AS (
    SELECT parent_molregno AS molregno FROM target_mols
    UNION
    SELECT mh.molregno FROM molecule_hierarchy mh JOIN target_mols tm ON mh.parent_molregno = tm.parent_molregno
)
SELECT 
    md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
    md.pref_name AS compound_preferred_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    a.activity_id,
    ass.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id,
    ass.description AS assay_description,
    td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_units,
    a.pchembl_value,
    d.doc_id,
    d.pubmed_id,
    d.doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN all_mols am ON a.molregno = am.molregno
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE 
    td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208'
    AND a.standard_type = 'IC50';
